newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL'S Timberwest raises Dec quarter earnings.
newsitem.headline: FCL'S Timberwest raises Dec quarter earnings.

text.p: TimberWest Forest Ltd, 52 percent owned by Fletcher Challenge Canada, had net earnings of C$18.7 million in the December quarter.
This compared with C$4.9 million in the same quarter of 1995, FCL Canada said on Friday.
December quarter sales were worth C$151.9 million compared with C$101.3 million.
Earnings for the three months reflected recognition of the benefit of a non-capital tax loss carried forward of C$9.1 million, or C$0.29 per common share.
The company enjoyed strength in the U.S. and Japanese lumber markets but said this was offset somewhat by a depressed pulp log market.
The quarter's results included those of the Mackenzie wood products operations, which were acquired in January 1996.
Demand for lumber had increased in both the North American and Japanese markets with strong housing activity in both segments, the company said.
